notes.semetey-1-2013:p0354:b003:l018: Кыяматтык жан бирге sworn companion through Judgment/hereafter; source religious bond retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0354:b003:l020: Uirulmo marsh followed by circling verb, Chogulma marsh by gathering verb; place-name wordplay preserved through transliteration plus verbs, not added alliterative prose.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0354:b003:l024: Тапкычташып/куугачташып pursuit/gathering reciprocal forms retained provisionally literal, no judicial procedure inferred.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b003:l002: Indented экен continuation grouped into one verse. Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b003:l019: Үйүң күйгөн curse house burn directed at fugitive Kanykei, source kinship vitriol retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b003:l033: Primary Yudakhin күч sense3 horse, exact «эки семиз күч берген, алты чанач сүт берген» two fat horses and six milk skins. Source here many skins, not six; preserve own numbers.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b005:l001: Primary Yudakhin тел lamb/foal fed by two mothers, hence well-fed; explicit dual-nursing lamb image retained, not assumed biological twins.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b005:l003: Indented дедиң го continuation grouped into one verse. Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b005:l007: Slander-eating excrement curse literal moderate English filth; no added obscene act.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b005:l008: Bakai describes concealing his Talas-sized self and Ken-Kol-sized body; epic bulk retained, not substituted innocent woman object.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b005:l027: Singular source кан: when the khan died, all died. Preserve retrospective lament without changing to plural khans or correcting still-living characters.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0355:b005:l033: Literal entertaining/receiving many guests retained in rhyme with telling tales; contextual function may be formulaic hospitality language, no invented narrative visitors.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l005: Flood warning future conditional destination; Kyrgyz evidential/hypothetical aspect preserved as must/will.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l026: Аяш ата: fatherhood of sworn/blood brothers’ children; render father’s sworn brother, not legal adoptive father.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l028: Primary Yudakhin ур III = нур radiance in illuminated-face context; not wart on moonlike face.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l031: Primary Yudakhin жеке II sense2 broad leather battle belt, exact жекени белге курчанган. Not individual/solitary or shoes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l032: Жети түмөн seven ten-thousands =70,000, distinct from ambiguous сан in preceding batch.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l033: Желбегей open/draped garment, does not necessarily mean entirely unarmored.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b003:l039: Yellow willow planted left in Beijing as source begins item parallel willow/throne; no lost verse at pageboundary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b004:l006: Primary Yudakhin май кыл sense3 blood-stain, exact golden throne/father Azyz killing quotation. Not grease/greedy luxury or destroy throne.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b004:l008: Source Azozyl father name preserved, not automatically Azyz/other recension.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b004:l009: Silver throne repetition retained independently of preceding gold throne.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b004:l018: Spirit appearance conditional if spirit present, no added real-world supernatural assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b004:l027: Зайыпбуруш mighty conquering champion: primary Manas2010 glossary1842 Сайыппуруш//зайыппуруш definition all-possessing greatwarrior, individually inspected this turn for288batch; no female-spouse reading.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0356:b004:l037: Black felt edging of hat phrase retained, continuing to Syrgak; no invented embroidery.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b003:l009: Buttered-wheat face simile retained rather than modern skin-tone diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b003:l011: Horse resembling Akkula, not necessarily resurrected identical horse; source өңдүү likeness retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b003:l020: Speaker explicitly calls herself mother here, confirms Kanykei account; no hidden-sister cover carried beyond ownsource.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b003:l031: Widow self-blaming swallowed/devoured father idiom literal grief rhetoric, not literal cannibalism assertion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b003:l034: Thirty-two age preserved source, no synchronization with other ages.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b003:l038: Мекенин read Mecca genitive, pairedIslam next; not мекен homeland whose genitive differs. Backbone/girded-loins imagery retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b004:l009: Zhet-Kait named ethnic/geographic designation preserved source spelling, not historically identified.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b004:l013: Кырк эки сан forty-two great hosts; сан may myriad/sometimes10,000 primaryYudakhin, no forced42×10,000 exactheadcount.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b004:l023: Burulcha identified daughter of Esen Khan here, retains source abduction/tribute boast without invented consent.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b004:l026: Flood unreachable Beijing epic place epithet retained, no factual hydrology claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0357:b004:l035: Six-month campaign source duration preserved, not normalized to other battles12days.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b003:l002: Primary Yudakhin бейпай torment/trouble, cause suffering; not invented weapon.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b003:l005: Indented баары өлүп continuation grouped; likewise358:3:8–9,11–12,15–16 separate complete verses. Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b003:l018: Forty-two сан hosts allegedly all died source rhetorical lament; subsequent survivors retained without correcting count.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b003:l033: Kanykei says Manas devoured/lostSyrgak in same grief metaphor; no gratuitous literal cannibalism detail.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b004:l001: Primary Yudakhin жыйгандаш sharer of acquired wealth, companion in world possessions; pairedhereafter faith.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b004:l003: Arbuudan named replacement mount brought by Bakai; no substitution to own Koktulpar.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b004:l030: Ыстандап variant Islamic battlecry immediatelypreceded Ыслам; earlier primaryдинистан=дин-ислам confirms phoneticvariation. Translate Islam, no newIstanplace.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b004:l036: Primary Yudakhin торчон mail-clad; iron-rope mail description, not nettrapper profession.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0358:b004:l037: Primary Yudakhin канжар кол mythic man whose hand can piercehorses/camels; dagger-handed men, not merely carrying daggers.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0359:b003:l033: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0359:b003:l039: Жапар is the divine name Jappar, not a new human character.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0359:b004:l007: Primary Yudakhin кожосан exact кожосан атаң = departed father as protecting spirit. Not a personal name Kozhosan.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0359:b004:l016: Кутпа is north according to primary Yudakhin; retain the source prayer direction rather than substituting qibla.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0359:b004:l019: Primary Yudakhin бута II / бута атым is arrow-flight distance; six bowshots retained without metric conversion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0359:b004:l039: Source spells Акыбай here, against Ажыбай nearby; preserve Akybai as printed, apparently a variant of the same companion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0360:b003:l015: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0360:b004:l001: Primary Yudakhin шыйпайт quotes this moustache/departure formula: smoothing the moustache before setting out toward the other world.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0360:b004:l014: Retain cutting the child’s twig literally; no unsupported identification as circumcision.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0361:b003:l009: Primary Yudakhin тушар: a horse’s leg between hoof and knee; тушардан кар means snow a horse-shin deep. Retain that depth measure for the blood-formed red stone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0361:b003:l021: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0361:b003:l030: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0361:b005:l004: Later371–373 explicitly identify the mournful inherited camel Zhelmayan; name here read singular, not generic plural swift she-camels.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0361:b005:l013: Primary Yudakhin мом II / мом темир means iron crowbar; entry quotes this exact verse with болот кетмен. Not wax or soft iron.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0361:b005:l037: Primary Yudakhin мом темир quotes this exact cave-water passage: use crowbars to open a channel for water through the cave.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0362:b003:l017: Арчанын күлү is juniper ashes in burial context; not the flower homonym in lament formulas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0362:b003:l032: Primary Yudakhin сыйнат refers to honor/splendor, variant зыйнат; not an invented horse name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0362:b003:l034: Image/extraction Кеминин retained in source, read as variant or loss in кепинин/кебинин, shroud, supported by cutting and binding funeral context. Asterisk is an edition glossary marker.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0362:b004:l024: Primary Yudakhin чайканды келбей калды explicitly means fitted freely, with ample room. Applied to the vast cave and funeral assembly, not an inability to move.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0363:b003:l006: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0363:b003:l022: Primary Yudakhin тасмия = дасмия, means/capital/property of livelihood, with exact тасмиясы такыр жок. Булу supplies possessions. Not religious invocation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0363:b005:l027: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0363:b005:l030: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0363:b005:l038: First-person Kanykei expects God to strike her; next page continues her confession, so Strike me, not Strike them.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0364:b003:l024: Буттап алтын measures gold by poods, not legged gold.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0364:b003:l038: Атан: gelded male camels. Preserve seventy and the later seven nights as distinct source quantities.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0364:b004:l038: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0365:b003:l006: Primary Yudakhin тундурма sense 2 concealed inside or buried with no external sign; entry quotes this exact five champions/hearth passage.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0365:b003:l008: Кылмышы жок refers to the five victims’ innocence, not a claim that the killing was not a crime; nextlines explicitly accept blood guilt.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0365:b004:l003: Primary Yudakhin күлбото is refractory clay. Preserve repetition across consecutive verses.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0365:b004:l017: Эркеч castrated male goats; render goat wethers explicitly rather than imply sheep. All repeated6000/7000 counts retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0365:b004:l021: Corrected source alignment: six ages on this verse, built to stand unbroken on following verse. Кылым temporal age/era in lasting monument context, not number of conquered peoples.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b003:l037: Corrected source alignment: white mausoleum here, if my foal enters on following verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b004:l005: Кара баскан in childbirth: the birth-demon belief; not dark skin or generic oppression.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b004:l009: Source changes Алгара to Алкара within one portrait; preserve printed variants rather than harmonizing them silently.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b004:l017: Primary Yudakhin най quotes алтын найлуу сыр канжа, a lacquered pipe with a golden stem. Source/image айлуу omits initial н compared with exact formula; restore golden stem with this explicit variant note.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b004:l020: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b004:l026: Селебе is a long straight sword in individually viewed Semetey1960 glossary374; update sheath simile accordingly.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0366:b004:l032: Shai is warrior patron per Semetey1960 glossary375 inspected earlier; preserve name without conflating with another figure.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b003:l002: Primary Yudakhin отогот: jeweled finial on a Kalmak/Chinese official or hero’s cap, with the exact шуру отогот маржан таш formula.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b003:l004: Каны is khan here, coordinated with the following list of rulers; not blood of Luntun.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b003:l018: Primary Yudakhin жалаңкыч = жалаңгыч death angel or terror; night terror retains threatening simile without clinical sleep diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b003:l029: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b003:l036: Corrected source alignment: Akkula reference remains on this source verse and let orphan see clearly on following verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b004:l006: Кой көз denotes brown eyes; чекир contrasts pale/light eyes, not squinting.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b004:l012: Аяш ата kinship through father’s sworn brotherhood; no unsupported legal adoption. Same usage in other portraits in this batch.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b004:l027: Individually inspected Semetey1960 glossary PDF374: Теке жоомарт — мыкты күлүк ат, аргымак; also enduring/strong. Translate strong enduring steed, not goat, generosity or an invented horse name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0367:b004:l035: Ырапыс is ribbed fabric per primary Semetey1960 glossary375 previously inspected.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0368:b003:l007: Source/image алмадай, literally apple-like, modifies neck. Retain unusual image without silently changing to ала/алман or inventing an animal comparison.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0368:b003:l030: Explicit Khan Bakai’s Көк тулпар supports named Kok Tulpar, including earlier appearances 354/355.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0368:b004:l017: Primary Yudakhin күндөш sense 2 rival; retain rivalry among fortunate warriors without altering to companion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0368:b004:l037: Kambar is patron of horses; source associates Kartkuron with the unseen patron, not a new human rider.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0369:b003:l002: Бааша variant падыша/баша supported by king-of-horses syntax; Kartkuron draws even wild asses to follow.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0369:b003:l034: Primary Yudakhin түпөк sense 3 decorative tassel explicitly quotes ычкыры түпөк, кырк муун: trouser drawstring with a tassel, forty sections. https://el-sozduk.kg/ТҮПӨК/ accessed2026-09-14. Restored from whole unresolved after exact dictionary aid.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0369:b003:l035: Үзүк is the roof felt of a yurt; retain hyperbolic hat size.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0369:b003:l038: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0369:b005:l021: Келеме denotes metal-thread embroidery; primary Yudakhin confirmed in prior batch, not merely silk.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b003:l006: Каймал fifth-year she-camel; асый mature age, тай-тайлак young camels. Avoid assuming all camels are yearlings or dromedaries.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b003:l028: Нар is crossbred camel term; source gives broad hump and later rear hump. Preserve nar without imposing a modern one-hump diagram.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b003:l033: Primary Yudakhin окто = нокто halter; confirmed repeatedly in next two pages, explicitly gold on head.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b005:l004: Preserve 95 mature years as the epic gives асый, not a converted modern birthday count; repeats preceding ninety-five.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b005:l015: Менде=mortal person; camel’s suffering torments the observer’s soul, not just a statement that camel has a tormented soul.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b005:l019: Кал is spot/mark; eye condition not securely diagnosed, so do not label cataracts or blindness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b005:l024: Суп glosses fine white cloth in primary Yudakhin/Semetey1960 glossary374. Sixty cloth units plus ammunition is literal reading; do not silently amend to пуд.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0371:b005:l028: Үптөй packs/equips, equipment listed just before.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b003:l004: Primary Yudakhin апторой/атборой means all/everywhere, with exact атборойду сыдырып travelled everywhere. Not a place called Atboroy.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b003:l007: Primary Yudakhin кожосан means protecting spirit; exact кожосан атаң = your departed father as protecting spirit. Apply also 359:4:7, not proper Kozhosan.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b003:l008: Corrected source alignment: Kokon khoja here, reach extended on following verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b003:l010: Primary Yudakhin муңчу is an officer conveying public complaints/petitions to the khan in Bukhara and Kokand, not generic scribe or mourner.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b003:l015: Primary Yudakhin буй кыл = throw into confusion; entry quotes white deer made cattle and foe thrown into turmoil.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b004:l020: Кутпа is north; same primary distinction from qibla elsewhere.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0372:b004:l032: Өлгөндө көргөн: child gained through mortal hardship, not literal posthumous birth.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0373:b003:l035: Source explicitly дүйнө бок, world as shit; preserve coarse register rather than sanitize.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0373:b004:l013: Image бирге in twelve-guide formula read as пирге variant; primary пир spiritual guide. Documented, not silent English borrowing.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0373:b004:l020: Отузунда leaves possessor implicit; render at thirty without assigning age to Manas or Bakai beyond source.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0373:b004:l037: Planting an orchard and building a house are explicit cultivation metaphors for Bakai’s upbringing/support of Manas, not separate construction projects.

Whole verse unresolved: image/extraction clearly Кызыр чалган жол өлүп, literally Kyzyr-blessed road died; жол in the list of slain people is not securely understood. No silent replacement with шер/lion or a guessed warrior name.

Whole verse unresolved: Жалгыз чымын ураткан follows Azhybai’s spear strike on a door; чымын may relate to fly/soul imagery, but exact action and object unresolved. Do not invent a guard killed or a door count.
Whole verse unresolved: кабажык means belt in primary Yudakhin, but back-wound context does not securely establish sense or source reading here. Do not invent abscess/carbuncle.

Whole verse unresolved: accepted/worsened and rotted are partly interpretable, but кузгундап final verb is not securely understood. Raven/scavenger dictionary entry is insufficient to assert gangrene or another wound diagnosis.

Whole verse unresolved: Төлгө ordinarily divination/omen, but resulting overgrown mosque context after shoots and plane trees is uncertain. Do not invent another tree or an explicit sacred divination site.

Whole verse unresolved: primary Yudakhin окчонтой is quiver, not powder flask, and its ок кылдым example concerns filling a quiver with arrows. Exact күбүп ок кылдым action here after poison and water cannot securely be fixed as firing or making arrows. No partial English published.
Whole verse unresolved: Акбандын in Akkula praise is not securely identified as a proper name, animal noun or epithet. Retain exact source; no automatic substitution айбандын.
